description: This Java class 'EnduranceTest' performs an endurance test by running a specified number of cycles, manipulating engine types and sending commands to hardware, logging progress and timing.

classes.name: EnduranceTest
classes.description: Main class for performing a hardware endurance test with repeated engine type settings and command sending.
